messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD incident fired for prometheus.scrape_failures (prod-cluster-2) — 18% scrape error rate across node-exporter and app-exporter. Pager: @samir oncall.

pagerduty: Alert attached — svc: metrics-pipeline, severity: P1, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metrics-scrape-failure 

samir: acked. looking now. any customer-facing alerts?

lucy: saw increased 5xxs in exporter logs earlier, esp app-exporter. logs piling in log-queue too.

maya: confirm kafka consumer lag up ~120k msgs, ingestion throttling. probable downstream bottleneck.

samir: ok triage plan: 1) confirm exporter restarts 2) check prometheus scrape timeout settings 3) scale metrics-consumer horizontally 4) notify product if customers might see missing metrics

lucy: grabbing exporter logs: ```kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/app-exporter -c exporter --since=10m``` getting repeated "dial tcp x.x.x.x:9100: i/o timeout" and a lot of `502` from nginx in front.

samir: runbook step1: rotate exporter pods (graceful) to clear stuck connections. doing: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/app-exporter -n monitoring```

maya: scaling metrics-consumer: ```k scale deployment metrics-consumer --replicas=8 -n infra``` — doing now.

samir: also bump prometheus scrape_timeout for app-exporter target from 5s -> 10s as temporary mitigation. patching configmap.

lucy: note: log-queue consumer backlog is the bigger risk for customer-facing dashboards. if we don't drain, dashboards will show stale data for hours.

maya: increasing consumer throughput helped — consumer lag dropped from 120k -> 60k in ~2m.

samir: exporter pods restarted, most are back to Running. scrape error rate falling to 6%.

lucy: still seeing intermittent 504s from nginx — looking at LB health and connection pool. adding connection reuse setting to nginx upstream as hotfix.

samir: quick customer assessment: affected metrics are internal service health + some low-traffic customer dashboards. no bulk data loss expected; logs will be backfilled as we drain. tagging CS to prep comms if we hit >30m impact window.

pagerduty: Escalation policy: if not resolved in 15m escalate to oncall+1. timer started.

maya: consumer lag at 10k now. rate of drain steady. dashboards starting to refresh.

lucy: nginx pool change applied: temp 504s stopped.

samir: confirming scrape errors <1% now. Prometheus targets healthy.

samir: marking mitigation steps in thread: restarted exporters, scaled consumers, bumped scrape_timeout, nginx pool hotfix. will leave PD open for postmortem link.

maya: will run backfill job for lost log window overnight: `scripts/log-backfill --start=2026-03-15T02:00Z --end=2026-03-15T02:20Z --topic=metrics-raw`

lucy: filing follow-up ticket with root cause hypothesis: upstream network flakiness + nginx connection pool exhaustion. assigning to eng-runtime to investigate persistent connection handling.

samir: de-escalating. if anyone sees regression ping here. great quick team work :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD incident resolved by samir — duration 12m. postmortem required if impact window > 10m.

maya: adding notes to incident board and linking runbook changes.

lucy: leaving logs and grafana snapshots in the thread: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/metrics-pipeline?from=now-30m&to=now

samir: final status: service healthy, backlog draining, follow-up ticket ENG-4321 created for nginx connection reuse and long-term consumer autoscaling. closing thread.
